e19as19k5e6x3.speaker: narr
e19as19k5e6x3.text: Among them stood five long, flat rocks in a row — just like ships with their sails up.

e630ho3kg0fg.text: On this mountain, people say those were ships, long ago.

ed6wxp1178fv.speaker: yeaymao
ed6wxp1178fv.text: Long, long ago, a prince called Preah Thong met Neang Neak, the daughter of the Naga king, by the sea.
ed6wxp1178fv.heard: Long, long ago, a prince called Preah Thong met Neang Neak, the daughter of the Naga king, by the sea.

et09yrhjo8y5.speaker: yeaymao
et09yrhjo8y5.text: So that the two of them could found a kingdom in the human world, they say, the Naga king gave them five ships loaded with treasure and servants.

eho4tdh1y8gj.speaker: yeaymao
eho4tdh1y8gj.text: Many, many years passed. The sea drew back far away, and the ships turned to stone. Only their sails were left above the ground, like this.
eho4tdh1y8gj.heard: Many, many years passed. The sea drew back far away, and the ships turned to stone. Only their sails were left above the ground, like this.

e1qrtpws5v9ec.text: Mountains near the sea are hit by damp sea winds, so clouds and mist form easily there. That’s why this mountain is always hidden in cloud.
